verses.1: He was forty-five years old when he became king. He ruled in Jerusalem for sixteen years. His mother’s name was Jerusha, daughter of Zadok.
verses.2: And He did what was right in the eyes of Jehovah, just as His father Uziah had done. But He did not go into the Temple of Jehovah. And the people continued to be corrupt.
verses.3: He built the upper gate of the Temple of Jehovah, and in the village of Ophel, he also built other structures.
verses.4: And he built cities in Mount Judea, and also built settlements in the mountains of Zion and in the heights.
verses.5: And he fought against King Benyamin. He defeated him, and in that year, the people of Benyamin gave him one hundred gold coins, as well as twelve thousand bolts of wool and linen. This was what the people of Benyamin returned to him in the second and third years.
verses.6: And Yotam became stronger, because he prepared his path before Jehovah, his God.
verses.7: And all of Joshua’s words, along with all his battles and actions, are recorded in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
verses.8: He reigned for forty-five years. He ruled in Jerusalem for sixteen years.
verses.9: And Yotham lay with his fathers. They buried him in the city of David. And Ahaz’s son became king after him.
